MultiHeadAttention.doc: Standard multi-head attention with optional causal masking.

SelfAttention.doc: Single-head self-attention; thin alias of MHA with ``num_heads=1``.

CausalSelfAttention.doc: Decoder-style attention that cannot peek at future tokens.

CrossAttention.doc: Attention from a query stream to a separate key/value stream.

WindowAttention.doc: Local attention restricted to fixed-size windows of length ``W``.

LinearAttention.doc: Linear-complexity attention via the kernel trick (Performer-lite).

FlashAttention.doc: Just MHA - kept as a separate class for naming clarity.

RotaryEmbedding.doc: Rotary positional embedding (Su et al. 2021 / LLaMA).

AttentionPooling.doc: Attention-weighted pooling with a single learnable query token.

InceptionBlock.doc: Naive Inception-v1 module: 1x1, 3x3, 5x5 and pool branches.

DenseBlock.doc: A dense block with ``num_layers`` densely-connected conv units.

SqueezeExcitation.doc: Hu et al. 2017 - SE channel attention.

CBAM.doc: Convolutional Block Attention Module - channel + spatial attention.

SpatialPyramidPooling.doc: Multi-scale pyramid average pooling, output is flattened.

FeaturePyramidNetwork.doc: Top-down FPN with lateral 1x1 connections (Lin et al. 2017).

ASPP.doc: Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling - DeepLab v3.

DeformableConv2d.doc: Deformable convolution v1 (Dai et al. 2017) implemented with grid_sample.

DeformableAttention.doc: Multi-head deformable attention (Zhu et al. - Deformable DETR).

Linear.doc: Plain dense layer ``y = W x + b``.

ConvBlock.doc: Conv2D -> Norm -> Activation. The most common conv "lego" piece.

GroupConv2d.doc: Grouped convolution - the precursor of depthwise conv.

Conv1d.doc: Alias for ``nn.Conv1d`` - kept for symmetry with the API surface.

Conv3d.doc: Alias for ``nn.Conv3d`` - kept for symmetry with the API surface.

SkipConnection.doc: Generic residual / skip wrapper: ``y = combine(f(x), x)``.

QuantizedLinearInt8.doc: Simulated INT8 linear: stores INT8 weights, dequantizes for matmul.

QuantizedLinear4bit.doc: Simulated 4-bit symmetric weight quantization stored two-per-byte.

MagnitudePruner.doc: Unstructured magnitude pruning by replacing the smallest-|w| weights with 0.

TokenPruner.doc: Drops the lowest-scoring tokens to a fixed keep ratio (DynamicViT-style).

LowRankLinear.doc: Replaces a dense ``in_features x out_features`` layer with two thin layers.

ColumnParallelLinear.doc: Linear whose ``out_features`` are sharded across the tensor-parallel group.

RowParallelLinear.doc: Linear whose ``in_features`` are sharded; performs all-reduce after matmul.

PipelineStage.doc: A single stage of a pipeline: takes input from prev stage, sends to next.

TokenEmbedding.doc: Standard learned word embedding with truncated-normal init.

SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding.doc: Vaswani et al. 2017 - non-learned sinusoidal positions.

CLIPLoss.doc: CLIP loss with a learnable temperature ``logit_scale``.

EqualLinear.doc: Equalized-LR linear used by Progressive GAN / StyleGAN.

StyleBlock.doc: Combines :class:`ModulatedConv2d` with noise injection and an activation.

MinibatchStdDev.doc: Karras et al. 2017 - appends per-batch std as an extra feature map.

ProgressiveGrowing.doc: Smooth fade between low- and high-resolution outputs by parameter ``alpha``.

VAE.doc: Minimal convolutional VAE; designed for 64x64 inputs by default.

AffineCouplingLayer.doc: RealNVP affine coupling: half the dims are scaled/shifted by the other half.

EnergyBasedModel.doc: Wraps any net so its scalar output is the energy ``E_theta(x)``.

DDPMScheduler.doc: Standard DDPM linear-beta scheduler with q-sample / step utilities.

MessagePassing.doc: Generic message passing: ``out = aggregate(message(x_src, x_dst, e))``.

GraphConv.doc: Symmetric-normalized GCN layer: ``X' = D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} X W``.

VectorStore.doc: Tiny in-memory vector store with cosine top-k search.

KVCache.doc: Per-layer growable cache for transformer decoding.

CLIPEncoder.doc: A dual encoder that maps a vision and a text tower into a joint space.

PerceiverResampler.doc: Compresses a long sequence of input tokens into ``num_latents`` queries.

QFormer.doc: Bridges a frozen image encoder and a frozen LLM via learnable query tokens.

MemoryAttention.doc: Cross-attention over an external memory bank (e.g. retrieved facts).

Sophia.doc: Sophia optimizer. Uses a Hutchinson-style Hessian diagonal estimate.

EMA.doc: Maintains an EMA copy of model parameters: ``theta_ema = d * theta_ema + (1-d) * theta``.

MixedPrecisionTrainer.doc: One-call training step with autocast + GradScaler.

CheckpointedSequential.doc: Sequential that runs each submodule under :func:`torch.utils.checkpoint`.

PolicyNetwork.doc: Stochastic policy ``pi_theta(a|s)`` for either discrete or continuous actions.

QNetwork.doc: Action-value ``Q(s, a)`` with a discrete output head.

ActorCritic.doc: Combined actor-critic network sharing a torso.

ReplayBuffer.doc: Fixed-capacity FIFO replay buffer with random sampling.

TargetNetwork.doc: Wrap a network and provide a frozen, slowly-updated copy.

LSTMCell.doc: LSTM cell with explicit input / forget / cell / output gates.

StateSpaceModel.doc: Diagonal SSM with learnable continuous parameters.

MambaBlock.doc: A small Mamba-style block: depthwise conv + selective scan + gate.

NeuralODE.doc: Continuous-depth network: integrate ``dh/dt = f_theta(h, t)`` with explicit Euler.

SpectralConv2d.doc: The core spectral conv used inside FNO.

FNOBlock.doc: Spectral conv + pointwise residual + nonlinearity (Li et al. 2020).

KANLayer.doc: A single layer of a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (Liu et al. 2024).

CapsuleLayer.doc: Fully-connected capsule layer with dynamic routing.

SlotAttention.doc: Slot Attention (Locatello et al. 2020) for object-centric learning.

FeedForward.doc: Vanilla two-layer MLP used inside transformer blocks.

SwiGLU.doc: SwiGLU FFN used in LLaMA / PaLM: ``Linear(SiLU(W1 x) * W3 x) -> W2``.

GEGLU.doc: GEGLU FFN: variant of GLU with a GELU gate (Shazeer 2020).

TransformerDecoderBlock.doc: Pre-norm decoder block: causal self-attn + cross-attn + MLP.

MixtureOfExperts.doc: Token-level top-k MoE FFN (Shazeer / Switch / Mixtral).

SwitchMoE.doc: Switch-Transformer style MoE: each token visits exactly one expert.

SinusoidalTimeEmbedding.doc: Diffusion-style sinusoidal embedding of integer timesteps.

TimestepMLP.doc: Sinusoidal embedding followed by a 2-layer MLP - used by DDPM/SD.

DownsampleBlock.doc: Strided 3x3 conv (or avg-pool) for halving spatial size.

UpsampleBlock.doc: Restores spatial resolution via interpolation, transposed conv, or pixel shuffle.

UNetResBlock.doc: Diffusion-style residual block conditioned on a time embedding.

NoisePredictor.doc: Wraps a UNet so it predicts noise ``epsilon_theta(x_t, t, c)``.

ZeroConv2d.doc: 1x1 conv initialized to zero - the connector ControlNet uses.

ControlNetBlock.doc: Toy ControlNet hint encoder - encodes control image and adds via ZeroConv.

LoRALinear.doc: Low-rank adapter for a frozen ``nn.Linear``: ``W' = W + (B A) * alpha/r``.

HyperNetwork.doc: Small network that generates ``in_dim -> out_dim`` weight matrices on-the-fly.

IPAdapterCrossAttention.doc: Two-stream cross-attention: text + image-prompt features (Ye et al. 2023).

PatchEmbedding.doc: Image -> sequence of patch tokens via a strided conv.

CLSToken.doc: Learnable [CLS] token prepended to each sequence.

SwinWindowAttention.doc: Standard non-shifted window attention used inside Swin blocks.

MaskedImageModeling.doc: MAE / BEiT-style head: mask a fraction of tokens, reconstruct them.
